name: SDB-005 (naphthyl)
summary: SDB-005 (also known as NA-PINAC using systematic EUDA nomenclature) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold online as a designer drug. It is presumed to be an agonist of the CB1 and CB2 cannabinoid receptors. SDB-005 is the indazole core analog of PB-22 where the 8-hydroxyquinoline has also been replaced with a naphthalene group. The code number SDB-005 was originally used by Samuel D.

pharmacology.text: It is presumed to be an agonist of the CB1 and CB2 cannabinoid receptors.

uses.text: SDB-005 (also known as NA-PINAC using systematic EUDA nomenclature) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold online as a designer drug. The code number SDB-005 was originally used by Samuel D. Bannister for a different compound, the N-phenyl instead of N-benzyl analogue of SDB-006, pictured.

summaryZh: SDB-005（也稱為NA-PINAC）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式為C23H22N2O2，是狡詐家藥物PB-22的結構類似物，其中PB-22中的吲哚基改為了SDB-005的吲唑基團，同時8-喹啉基改成了1-萘基。
summaryZhHans: SDB-005（也称为NA-PINAC）是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式为C23H22N2O2，是狡诈家药物PB-22的结构类似物，其中PB-22中的吲哚基改为了SDB-005的吲唑基团，同时8-喹啉基改成了1-萘基。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Synthetic cannabinoids as a group can cause anxiety, paranoia, a racing heart, vomiting, confusion and psychosis, and have been linked to seizures, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths. Regular use can lead to dependence and difficult withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。合成大麻素整體而言可能引起焦慮、偏執、心跳過快、嘔吐、意識混亂和精神病症狀，也曾與癲癇發作、腎損傷、心臟病發作和死亡有關。規律使用可能導致依賴和難熬的戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。合成大麻素整体而言可能引起焦虑、偏执、心跳过快、呕吐、意识混乱和精神病症状，也曾与癫痫发作、肾损伤、心脏病发作和死亡有关。规律使用可能导致依赖和难熬的戒断症状。

fact.en: Its SDB code comes from Samuel D. Banister, a chemist who published syntheses of many synthetic cannabinoids so that laboratories would have reference standards for testing.
fact.zh: 它的 SDB 代號來自化學家 Samuel D. Banister，他發表了許多合成大麻素的合成方法，讓檢驗實驗室能有參考標準品。
